crossRefs.note: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come.…
They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal, and burned them.
They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
translations.bsb: First, Ahab set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he had built in Samaria.
translations.kjv: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
translations.asv: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
